data.case_title: Housing benefit (Wohngeld) decision from Landkreis Musterspree-Neiße
data.summary: The Wohngeldstelle of Landkreis Musterspree-Neiße approved Ronny Musterspree a Wohngeld (housing benefit) rent subsidy of €226.00 per month for the period from 1 December 2026 to 30 November 2027, based on three household members and a gross cold rent (Bruttokaltmiete) of €690.00. The office asks him to submit payslips for November and December 2026 by 11 January 2027, since his employer announced more working hours from January, to check whether the benefit needs to change.
data.explanation: This is an official decision (Bescheid) granting you housing benefit (Wohngeld) of €226.00 a month from 1 December 2026 to 30 November 2027. Because your employer announced more hours starting in January, the office needs your payslips (Lohnabrechnungen) for November and December 2026 by 11 January 2027 to check whether your benefit should be adjusted — send copies by then. If you disagree with this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) against it; the app shows the deadline for this. If you miss the payslip deadline, the office may not be able to properly verify your continued entitlement.

remedy.period_text: innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids
remedy.form_text: Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.
remedy.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Landkreis Musterspree-Neiße, Amtsplatz 3, 15848 Beispielkow); Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.
